greeting_message: Hello! Welcome to our medical clinic. I'm your AI assistant and I can help you schedule appointments, find the right doctor, or answer general questions about our services. How may I assist you?
fallback_message: For this query, I'd recommend speaking with our clinic staff directly. Please call our reception or leave your contact details and we'll reach out to you.

knowledge_base.title: Clinic FAQ
knowledge_base.content:
Q: What are your consultation hours?
A: Our clinic operates Monday to Saturday. General consultations are available all day. Specialist timings vary - please ask about specific doctors.

Q: Do I need to fast for blood tests?
A: For most blood tests including lipid profile and blood sugar, we recommend fasting for 10-12 hours before the test. Water is fine.

Q: How do I get my lab reports?
A: Lab reports are typically available within 24-48 hours. You can collect them from our reception or we can send them via email/WhatsApp.

Q: Do you accept health insurance?
A: Yes, we accept most major health insurance providers. Please carry your insurance card and ID.

Q: Is there parking available?
A: Yes, we have free parking available for patients in our building basement.

knowledge_base.title: Pre-Visit Instructions
knowledge_base.content:
Before Your Visit:
- Bring your previous medical records and prescriptions
- Carry your insurance card and photo ID
- Arrive 10 minutes early for registration if you're a new patient
- Prepare a list of current medications and allergies
- Fast for 10-12 hours if you have blood tests scheduled

Emergency:
- For medical emergencies, call 108 or visit the nearest emergency room
- Our clinic handles minor emergencies and can provide first-aid
- For after-hours medical advice, call our helpline
